patch.objective: Regularly evaluating new and existing risks against strategic objectives and presenting updates to the governance board

sources.cite: PMI, Program Management Professional (PgMP) Examination Content Outline: Strategic Program Alignment 15%, Program Life Cycle Management 44%, Benefits Management 11%, Stakeholder Engagement 16%, Governance 14%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17. The domain weights were confirmed through a summarizing fetch of a training provider's article (eartech.pmtraining.com, 'How to Prepare for the PgMP Certification Exam'), which describes Program Life Cycle Management as 'initiating, planning, executing, controlling, and closing the program across its phases' and Governance as 'the boards, gates, and decision rights that let leadership steer and, when needed, stop a program'. PMI's own outline PDF did not come up in search and PMI's PgMP pages read today do not list the domains; the task wording is the course seed's, to verify against PMI's PDF. Reused for REQ-336 from this course's pgmp-transit-program-steering-review (the same reading and date); the objective wording is the course seed's.

The organization, the project, the figures and the people are fictional. The minutes or days each step takes and the effects of each decision are teaching simplifications for exam practice, not measured values.
